PocketPaint

Local, in-browser image generation — no server, no API key, runs in ~3 GB RAM.

Prompt & Settings

🧬/🌀 are both ours — trained from scratch, embedded in this file, zero downloads. 🧬 is a conditional neural field (instant, very smooth); 🌀 is a real small diffusion model (conditional UNet, iterative denoising) — slower but a genuine noise→image generative process. ⚡ is a non-learned procedural renderer. 🧠 downloads a real pretrained Stable-Diffusion-class model (see setup panel below).

🧠 Diffusion mode setup (optional, real Stable Diffusion)

This engine runs a genuine pretrained text-to-image diffusion model (SD-Turbo, exported to ONNX) fully client-side via ONNX Runtime Web + WebGPU — real CLIP tokenizer, real text encoder, real UNet denoising, real VAE decode. It's a real Stable-Diffusion model, so it's ~2.5 GB to download and requires actual WebGPU support (this specific export's graph uses fused ops only the WebGPU kernels implement — it won't run on the WASM-only fallback), plus a desktop-class RAM budget; this device's current budget is shown above (). It will not fit on an iPad 9 or similar — that's what the built-in 🧬 Neural model is for. Files are cached by the browser after the first download.

Advanced: use your own ONNX model files instead

Pick your own .onnx file(s) (e.g. a different quantized export). This bypasses the recommended pipeline above and falls back to a best-effort single forward-pass bridge, since a full tokenizer/scheduler/VAE loop is specific to the SD-Turbo export wired in above.

License: SD-Turbo is distributed by Stability AI under a non-commercial research license — personal/research use only. If a model isn't loaded or doesn't fit in memory, the app falls back to the built-in neural model and tells you why.

🧬 Neural model (default): a real ~31k-parameter neural network trained from scratch (a conditional neural field) that generates scenes — sky by time of day, ground by biome, optional mountains / neon / fire, plus simple subjects like a person, horse, dog, car, bird, boat, tree or building — from your prompt. The trained weights are embedded in this file (~165 KB), so it runs fully offline with no downloads and fits the iPad-9 memory budget. ⚡ Procedural is the instant WebGPU keyword-art engine; 🧠 Diffusion is the optional bring-your-own-ONNX path.
